templates.body: You are an operations coordinator. Write a short, polite follow-up email to {client} about {task}. Mention it was due on {due_date}, ask for an updated timeline, and offer help if anything is blocked. Reply as a short email with a subject line.
templates.purpose: Polite follow-up email for an overdue operations task

templates.body: You are an operations coordinator. Summarise the status of {task} for {client} in a short bullet list: what is done, what is open, and the next step. Keep it factual and under 120 words.
templates.purpose: Client status update from a task list

templates.body: You are an operations coordinator. Triage this request: {task}. Reply as a table with category, priority, owner, and next action, then one sentence explaining the priority.
templates.purpose: Triage summary for a new incoming request

templates.body: You are an operations coordinator. Turn these notes into a meeting recap for {client}: {task}. Reply as a bullet list of decisions, then a table of action items with owner and due date.
templates.purpose: Meeting recap with owners and deadlines
